subject: Insurance
title: Modeling Emerging Risks
description: A 60-second lesson on Modeling Emerging Risks.

hook.text: How do you model a risk that's never happened? Cyber attacks, AI liability.

buildup.text: Traditional actuarial science needs decades of data. Emerging risks offer years at most.

twist.text: The insurance industry was slow to model cyber risk.

climax.text: Emerging risks are the frontier of insurance science.

punchline.text: No data, no history. Emerging risks force insurers to model the unprecedented.

quiz.question: How do insurers model risks with no historical data?
options: Scenario-based modeling with expert-estimated worst cases
